title: One Who Calls Himself A Guru
summary: Seva is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around
lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around
source.lifeApplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Let the line meet the ordinary room before self-judgment starts arranging it.

evidence.coreClaim: One who calls himself a guru or a spiritual teacher, while he goes around
evidence.turn: The path is not performed through appearance. It is walked through honest labor and giving.
evidence.practicalImplication: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
